description: List service trade categories from the combined EB catalog, including numeric EBOPS and SDMX codes. Returns category codes, descriptions, parent codes, and the EBOPS scheme catalogs that list each code: EB10 (EBOPS 2010), EB10S (EBOPS 2010 SDMX codes), EB02 (EBOPS 2002). Filter by keyword (e.g. "transport", "financial", "travel") or browse direct children of a parent code; "200" lists the EB10 and EB02 top levels. Use the returned id as service_code in comtrade_get_services_trade. Code 3 is transport; SA is manufacturing services. Each page holds up to limit categories; continue with nextOffset using the same query and parent_code.

limit.description: Maximum categories returned per page; defaults to 100.

offset.description: Number of matching categories to skip; use nextOffset to continue.

parent_code.description: Return direct children of this EB category code. Examples: "3" for transport sub-categories, "3.1" for sea transport sub-categories, or "200" for the EB10 and EB02 top-level categories.

query.description: Keyword or category code prefix to filter results; codes compare case-insensitively and keep their dots. Examples: "transport", "SA", "3.1", "financial services". Omit, or leave blank, to list all EB categories.

name: comtrade_list_service_categories

categories.description: EB service categories on this page. With a query, ranked exact code, code prefix, whole-word description match, then other description matches; ties, and an unfiltered listing, keep catalog order.

items.description: A service trade category from the combined EB catalog.

ebParent.description: Parent the combined EB catalog gives this code when it differs from parent: TOTAL for EB10 top-level codes.

id.description: EBOPS category code (use as service_code in trade queries).

parent.description: Parent category code, if any; EB10 top-level codes take 200 from the EB10 catalog.

schemes.description: EBOPS scheme catalogs listing this code: EB10 (EBOPS 2010), EB10S (EBOPS 2010 SDMX codes), EB02 (EBOPS 2002). Empty when no scheme catalog lists it; absent when the scheme catalogs could not be loaded.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page; absent when no matching categories remain.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no categories match, matches remain past this page, the offset is past the end, or scheme tags are unavailable.

offset.description: Number of matching categories skipped for this page.

shown.description: Number of categories returned on this page.

totalMatches.description: Total matching categories across all pages.

truncated.description: Whether this page holds only part of the matching categories (shown < totalMatches).

title: List Service Trade Categories (EB)
